newsitem.title: UK: London Bridge buys CheckFree Corp unit.
newsitem.headline: London Bridge buys CheckFree Corp unit.

text.p: London Bridge Software Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it had signed a conditional agreement to acquire a division of CheckFree Corporation of the U.S. for a maximum consideration of 21 million stg.
London Bridge said it was planning to buy the recovery management system division of CheckFree which supplies debt recovery software solutions to credit risk management firms in the U.S.
Based in Atlanta, the unit employs 30 people.
The company said it would raise about 17 million stg, before expenses by issuing 5.5 million stock units in the ratio of four for every 17 shares held on July 11, 1997.
The company's share price was up by 12-1/2 pence at 335p at 1430 GMT.
